Enabled.Label: Enable Effects
Enabled.Hint: Apply the Tile FX Painter shader effects to this tile.

Shader.Label: Shader
Shader.Hint: The shader effect to apply to this tile.

Opacity.Label: Effect Opacity
Opacity.Hint: How visible the effect is on the tile. 0 is invisible, 1 is fully visible.

Intensity.Label: Effect Intensity
Intensity.Hint: The strength of the shader effect.
